note: report-export turns an ALREADY-GENERATED .marvin/ report into a shareable artifact (PDF, print-ready HTML, Markdown digest) by filling the shipped template in-session (ADR-0033). Its neighbourhood is crowded with two prompts that have no SKILL.md and so are absent from the catalog a decider is shown — /marvin:reports (list every generated report) and /marvin:sec-report (list security findings by severity). Those cannot be competition winners; they appear in negative notes instead. The competition rows name real, catalog-reachable siblings (handoff, changelog). The sharpest distinction to measure: producing a report versus SHARING one that already exists.
